status_legend.PASS_SOURCE_ESTABLISHED: The pinned source establishes the stated behavior within the declared scope.
status_legend.PARTIAL_SOURCE_BOUND: The pinned source establishes part of the claim but leaves an enumerated boundary unresolved.
status_legend.FAIL_MISSING: A required binding is absent and is not inferred.
status_legend.FAIL_CONFLICT: The pinned source behavior conflicts with the frozen v5 requirement or another pinned source claim.
status_legend.DEFER_REQUIRES_DATA_OR_RUN: The item cannot be closed by source inspection and is deferred to authorized acquisition or execution.

dimensions.criterion: Reconfirm detached revision, source hashes, owner identity and code license from materialized files.
dimensions.assessment: Detached revision, clean worktree, and all selected raw-byte hashes replay exactly. The package declares version 1.2.1, RecBoleTeam/RUCAIBox identity, and MIT licensing.

dimensions.criterion: Extract Python/framework/direct dependency declarations and identify every version/platform/transitive gap; never invent a lock.
dimensions.assessment: Direct requirements are declared, but they are predominantly lower bounds, two declarations differ, Python and platform are not constrained, and no complete direct/transitive lock or runtime receipt is present.

dimensions.criterion: Trace the exact source-owned training entrypoint, method registration, config precedence, defaults, seed and tuning surfaces.
dimensions.assessment: The source-owned quick-start path, BPR registration, merge precedence, default BPR/ml-100k settings, pairwise objective, seed calls, validation checkpoint rule, and tuning entrypoints are all locatable. This establishes source behavior, not the README producer configuration.

dimensions.criterion: Trace metric formula, full/sampled candidate construction, seen-item masking, aggregation and tie behavior with exact file/symbol locators.
dimensions.assessment: Full-sort scoring, padding/seen masking, HR/NDCG formulae, and user-mean aggregation are explicit. Top-k ties have no source-defined raw-ID secondary key, and source GAUC is positive-count weighted rather than the frozen v5 macro user mean. The stock evaluator therefore cannot be the harmonized v5 evaluator.

dimensions.criterion: Identify whether schema/cardinality/filtering/tuning/checkpoint selection can derive from evaluation TEST; absence of proof remains partial.
dimensions.assessment: Dataset filtering and ID remapping precede splitting, so schema/cardinality can be transductive. The normal trainer selects checkpoints on validation, but the quick-start automatically evaluates TEST afterward and the stock hyperparameter objective evaluates TEST on every trial; Ray tuning selects a reported TEST recall metric. No source-enforced TEST seal exists.

dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the stored numeric target is tied to this exact revision, data, full config, seed, environment, evaluator and run receipt.
dimensions.assessment: README NDCG@10=0.2768 is illustrative documentation for a BPR/ml-100k random 80/10/10 full-sort example, not an immutable producer receipt. Revision-producing commit, provider bytes, complete resolved config, actual seed, environment, checkpoint, predictions, tie behavior, and run receipt are absent; the README model label also conflicts with the pinned class name.

dimensions.criterion: Identify source data loaders/converters and the exact additional provider-byte and transformation receipts required later; do not acquire data.
dimensions.assessment: The source declares a processed-dataset URL, archive download/extract/rename behavior, and the expected ml-100k atomic fields. No dataset bytes, provider release/rights receipt, archive hash, extracted-file hashes, or transformation receipt are in the selected tree.

dimensions.criterion: Map v5 fields to source interfaces and decide whether a representation-only adapter is plausibly bounded without changing objective or evaluator.
dimensions.assessment: Raw-to-internal ID maps and complete per-user item score vectors provide a bounded score-export seam that can preserve BPR mathematics. Readiness remains blocked because the stock pre-split loader concatenates all split files before remapping, source top-k/tie/GAUC semantics cannot implement v5, and a TEST-sealed orchestration plus standalone v5 evaluator and parity fixtures do not exist.

dimensions.criterion: List the minimal dataset, environment, config, parity and rerun actions needed before benchmark admission or execution.
dimensions.assessment: The source returns scalar result dictionaries and saves a checkpoint, but it does not emit the immutable data/config/environment/prediction/evaluator receipt chain required by the frozen project contract. Closure therefore requires a separately authorized R5-M2 proposal and later runs.

facts.claim: The materialized package declares RecBole version 1.2.1.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: __version__ is assigned the string 1.2.1.
facts.scope_limit: A package version declaration does not by itself prove the producing environment or numeric result.

facts.claim: The source carries an MIT License with a 2020 RUCAIBox copyright notice.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The file is headed MIT License, identifies Copyright (c) 2020 RUCAIBox, and states the MIT grant and conditions.
facts.scope_limit: This establishes the code-tree license notice only; dataset rights are separate and absent.

facts.claim: Package metadata identifies RecBoleTeam as author and the RUCAIBox/RecBole repository URL.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: setup() declares name recbole, version 1.2.1, URL https://github.com/RUCAIBox/RecBole, author RecBoleTeam, and an MIT classifier.
facts.scope_limit: Metadata identity is not a dataset-provider or run-producer attestation.

facts.claim: setup.py declares direct dependencies but mostly as open lower bounds rather than exact versions.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: torch>=1.10.0, numpy>=1.17.2, scipy>=1.6.0, pandas>=1.3.0 and other lower bounds are declared; colorlog 4.7.2 and colorama 0.4.4 are exact; Ray is bounded; hyperopt is an exact optional extra.
facts.scope_limit: No resolved direct set, transitive graph, wheel/build identity, interpreter, OS, accelerator, or driver is fixed.

facts.claim: requirements.txt is a second non-lock direct-dependency declaration with predominantly open lower bounds and an exact hyperopt entry.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The file uses lower bounds for Torch, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, colorlog, colorama, and other packages, includes hyperopt==0.2.5, and does not enumerate transitive artifacts.
facts.scope_limit: Compared with the separately recorded setup.py fact, declaration differences remain unresolved; the audit does not choose or infer installed versions.

facts.claim: The package metadata does not declare a Python version requirement or a platform/runtime lock.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: setup(...) call, lines 52-68; no python_requires or platform constraint
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The setup call has package, version, author, dependency, and classifier fields but no python_requires, lock hash, OS, CUDA, cuDNN, driver, CPU, or GPU binding.
facts.scope_limit: Absence is reported without inferring a compatible Python or hardware version.

facts.claim: The source-owned CLI entrypoint defaults to model BPR and dataset ml-100k and delegates to the quick-start run API.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: argparse defaults --model to BPR and --dataset to ml-100k, splits config_files, and calls run(...).
facts.scope_limit: This establishes current defaults, not the exact argv of the README-producing run.

facts.claim: For ordinary parameters, external precedence is config files in list order, then config_dict, then --name=value CLI arguments.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Each later config file updates the same dictionary; external merging then updates file values with config_dict and finally command-line values.
facts.scope_limit: Only CLI tokens of the form --name=value enter Config; other tokens are warned as unused by this parser.

facts.claim: Internal defaults merge overall, model, sample-dataset, and named-dataset YAML in that order, after which the merged external dictionary overrides internal values.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The internal file loop is overall, model, sample, dataset; final_config_dict updates internal first and external second.
facts.scope_limit: The merge algorithm does not supply an immutable resolved-config receipt.

facts.claim: Explicit model and dataset function arguments take identity precedence over external model/dataset values.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: External model or dataset is consulted only when the corresponding constructor argument is None; run_recbole.py passes both defaults explicitly.
facts.scope_limit: This special identity precedence is distinct from ordinary parameter precedence.

facts.claim: Default training uses seed 2020, reproducibility true, 300 epochs, Adam at 0.001, one uniform training negative, and validation MRR@10 early stopping with patience threshold 10.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The YAML also defaults to user-grouped random 0.8/0.1/0.1 splitting, random order, full evaluation, topk 10, and Recall/MRR/NDCG/Hit/Precision.
facts.scope_limit: Defaults are overrideable and are not proof of the README producer's resolved values.

facts.claim: Seed initialization covers Python random, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA, and cuDNN benchmark/deterministic flags.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: init_seed calls random.seed, np.random.seed, torch.manual_seed, CUDA seed functions, then toggles cuDNN benchmark and deterministic.
facts.scope_limit: The source does not prove every operation deterministic for an unresolved Torch/platform build, and no producer seed receipt exists.

facts.claim: The pinned BPR implementation is pairwise matrix factorization with config-supplied embedding size and dot-product positive and negative scores passed to BPRLoss.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: class BPR, __init__, calculate_loss, predict, full_sort_predict, lines 27-97
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: BPR declares pairwise input, reads embedding_size from config, creates user/item embeddings, passes positive and negative dot-product scores to BPRLoss, and multiplies users against every item embedding for full-sort scores.
facts.scope_limit: This establishes method mathematics, not trained parameters or a result.

facts.claim: Full-sort evaluation reshapes scores over the complete internal item cardinality, masks padding item 0, and masks history items to negative infinity.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Scores are viewed as users by tot_item_num, scores[:,0] is set to -inf, and scores at history_index are set to -inf.
facts.scope_limit: The internal item universe is data-derived and is not proven equal to the frozen 5,200-item v5 catalog.

facts.claim: For full-sort evaluation, the loader defines each user's history mask as the sampler-provided used-item set minus current positive items.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The loader reads sampler.used_ids, collects each user's target positive set, and stores history_item = used_item - positive_item.
facts.scope_limit: Unless target truth is prefiltered to novel items, a target item also present in prior history is removed from the mask; v5 requires novel-only truth and all seen items masked.

facts.claim: Top-k ranking uses torch.topk without an explicit equal-score secondary key, so the source does not implement the v5 score-descending/raw_product_id-ascending tie contract.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Both rec.items and rec.topk call torch.topk(scores_tensor, max(topk), dim=-1); no stable flag, item-ID sort, or secondary comparison appears.
facts.scope_limit: Equal-score ordering is delegated to the unresolved Torch runtime and is not inferred from item indices.

facts.claim: Source NDCG uses binary relevance, logarithmic discount, and IDCG capped by min(positive count, k).
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: DCG and IDCG are cumulative 1/log2(rank+1) arrays, IDCG length is capped by positive count and cutoff, and the per-user result is dcg/idcg.
facts.scope_limit: Formula alignment alone does not align candidate universe, eligible-user denominator, novel truth, split, or tie ordering.

facts.claim: Source Hit@k is one when at least one relevant item appears by k.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The cumulative positive indicator is thresholded at greater than zero for each rank position.
facts.scope_limit: It matches v5 HR only after v5 eligibility, truth, candidate, masking, and tie contracts are enforced.

facts.claim: Source GAUC aggregates user AUC weighted by each user's positive count, conflicting with v5's unweighted macro per-user GAUC.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: GAUC computes user_auc and returns sum(user_auc * pos_len)/sum(pos_len).
facts.scope_limit: This source GAUC must remain on the official-source seam and cannot be relabeled as v5 GAUC.

facts.claim: The default dataset path loads and preprocesses the complete interaction table before evaluation splitting, so filtering, ID maps, and cardinalities can depend on held-out records.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Loading, filtering, remapping, feature preparation, imputation, label conversion, and normalization occur before build() orders and splits interactions.
facts.scope_limit: This is a source-level transductive surface; no claim is made that it changed the README number or that all such preprocessing is necessarily statistically harmful.

facts.claim: The stock default uses random ordering and user-grouped random 80/10/10 splitting rather than the frozen v5 temporal boundaries.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: Dataset.build, lines 1824-1853; defaults in overall.yaml lines 41-45
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: RO calls shuffle(); RS with group_by user calls split_by_ratio per user. The default ratios are 0.8, 0.1, 0.1.
facts.scope_limit: A future official-source reproduction may use this source surface, but a harmonized v5 run may not.

facts.claim: The normal trainer chooses and saves checkpoints using the configured validation metric.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Validation score drives early_stopping and update_flag; an improved score causes the checkpoint and best_valid_result to update.
facts.scope_limit: Validation-based selection is source-established, but this trainer fact does not establish a project TEST seal or producer receipt.

facts.claim: The stock hyperparameter objective evaluates TEST on every trial and reports the resulting metrics to the tuning backend.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: objective_function fits on train/valid, evaluates test, calls tune.report with test_result, and returns test_result.
facts.scope_limit: This stock objective is inadmissible for v5 regardless of whether a calling tuner chooses parameters from another returned field.

facts.claim: README documents an illustrative BPR/ml-100k example with random 80/10/10 splitting, full negative sampling, and test NDCG@10 of 0.2768.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The README says the script runs BPR on ml-100k, shows random by-ratio 0.8/0.1/0.1 and full evaluation, then lists ndcg@10: 0.2768 in the test result.
facts.scope_limit: This is documentation evidence for a method/dataset/evaluator family, not an immutable producer binding or v5-comparable result.

facts.claim: The README numeric example does not bind its producing revision, dataset bytes, complete resolved config, actual seed, environment, checkpoint, prediction artifact, tie policy, or run receipt.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: wording 'We will obtain some output like' and output block, lines 154-191
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The example is introduced as output 'like' the shown block and contains log excerpts only; none of the required immutable producer fields is present.
facts.scope_limit: Current source defaults cannot be backfilled as historical producer facts.

facts.claim: The README output names the model BPRMF.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The shown model representation begins INFO BPRMF(...).
facts.scope_limit: The label mismatch does not prove different mathematics, but it prevents exact executable-surface identity from documentation alone.

facts.claim: The source maps ml-100k to a RecBole-hosted processed-dataset archive URL.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: ml-100k points to a ProcessedDatasets/MovieLens/ml-100k.zip URL on RecBole's S3 endpoint.
facts.scope_limit: A URL is not provider-byte identity, release identity, rights evidence, or a hash; no acquisition occurred.

facts.claim: The dataset loader would download, extract, remove the archive, and rename atomic files when the configured dataset path is absent.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: _download resolves the URL, downloads and extracts the zip, deletes it, and calls rename_atomic_files; _load_data invokes this when dataset_path does not exist.
facts.scope_limit: The audit did not call this path. Future closure must hash the provider archive and every transformed atomic file and record the rename/extract toolchain.

facts.claim: The ml-100k config loads user_id, item_id, rating, and timestamp and applies no rating threshold by default.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: basic information and load_col, lines 5-12 and 30-41
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The interaction columns are the four named fields and threshold is null, so the default BPR surface does not source-define a rating cutoff.
facts.scope_limit: No atomic file bytes are present, and the audit does not infer provider release, schema values, or transformation history.

facts.claim: The dataset interface provides reversible raw-token/internal-ID mappings suitable for a representation-preserving ID adapter.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: pandas.factorize creates IDs starting at 1 with [PAD] at 0 and stores both field2id_token and field2token_id; token2id/id2token expose both directions.
facts.scope_limit: Parity still requires a frozen raw_product_id map, unknown/duplicate policy, and byte hashes.

facts.claim: BPR can export an untruncated per-user score vector over all internal item embeddings without changing its training objective.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: full_sort_predict multiplies each selected user embedding by the transpose of the complete item-embedding matrix and returns the flattened scores.
facts.scope_limit: A future adapter must export full scores plus raw IDs before source top-k, prove all 5,200 v5 products are represented, and exclude padding.

facts.claim: RecBole's pre-split benchmark-file interface concatenates every named split before global preprocessing and returns them later by stored file sizes.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: Each benchmark suffix is loaded, all frames are concatenated, global processing/remapping occurs, and build later slices by file_size_list.
facts.scope_limit: Placing sealed v5 TEST in this path before authorization is inadmissible; a project-owned TEST-sealed orchestration seam must be designed and parity-tested without editing vendor source.

facts.claim: The quick-start surface logs argv/config and returns best-validation and test metric dictionaries but does not produce the project's immutable lineage and receipt bundle.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The function constructs Config, seeds, creates/splits data, fits, evaluates, logs environment and results, and returns scalar result dictionaries.
facts.scope_limit: No dataset lineage hash, resolved-config hash, environment-lock hash, checkpoint hash, prediction hash, evaluator hash, per-user artifact, or TEST authorization receipt is emitted.

facts.claim: The shared top-k metric aggregator computes an unweighted arithmetic mean over evaluated users before selecting requested cutoffs.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: topk_result applies value.mean(axis=0), then emits each configured k with metric_decimal_place rounding.
facts.scope_limit: The evaluated-user population comes from the dataloader; source aggregation does not by itself enforce v5 eligible-user construction.

facts.claim: The source GAUC rank collector assigns average ranks to equal scores.
facts.symbol_or_line_locator: Collector._average_rank and rec.meanrank collection, lines 96-135 and 171-188
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: After descending torch.sort, adjacent equal scores are grouped and assigned the midpoint of their occupied rank positions.
facts.scope_limit: This average-rank rule applies to GAUC collection, not to torch.topk ordering for HR/NDCG.

facts.claim: The stock Ray tuning path selects the best trial by recall@10 from the metrics reported by objective_function, which are TEST metrics.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: ASHAScheduler is configured for recall@10 and result.get_best_trial selects recall@10; objective_function separately establishes that tune.report receives test_result.
facts.scope_limit: This path is forbidden for v5 tuning and must not be repaired by assuming the metric came from validation.

facts.claim: The pinned executable model class is named BPR, not BPRMF.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: The model module declares class BPR(GeneralRecommender).
facts.scope_limit: Together with the README BPRMF fact, this is an identity-label conflict; it does not prove the underlying historical algorithm differed.

facts.claim: Sampler used-item sets are cumulative by phase: validation includes train plus validation interactions and test includes train, validation, plus test interactions.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: For each phase, cur copies the prior phase's sets and adds current interactions; set_phase selects that phase's cumulative array.
facts.scope_limit: The full-sort loader subsequently subtracts current positives; exact v5 novel-truth behavior still requires externally frozen truth preparation.

facts.claim: BPRLoss is the mean negative log sigmoid of the positive-minus-negative score, with gamma 1e-10 added inside the log.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: forward returns -log(gamma + sigmoid(pos_score - neg_score)).mean().
facts.scope_limit: This establishes the training objective only, not optimizer state, sampled negatives, or trained parameters.

facts.claim: The model-specific BPR default embedding size is 64.
facts.evidence_excerpt_or_paraphrase: embedding_size is set to 64 in the BPR model YAML.
facts.scope_limit: This is an overrideable current default, not proof that the README producer used 64.
